operation_details.item: The user uses Linear for issue tracking.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: As you scale your companies, it may help to clarify how your team handles documentation, communication, and issue tracking.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a central place for operating information and product context. Which channel do you use for day-to-day team communication?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Slack for team communication.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A clear communication channel can make coordination easier as initiatives expand. Where should someone look to understand the full set of tools?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: All project tools are listed in the onboarding doc.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes the onboarding path more discoverable. What do you use to manage issues and track work?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Linear for issue tracking.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That creates a straightforward division between documentation, communication, and issue tracking. Keeping those roles clear can support consistent execution while you focus on innovation and scaling.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the workflow to remain easy for people to understand as the companies grow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A concise onboarding path and clearly assigned tool roles should help preserve that clarity without adding unnecessary process.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I will keep the tool choices visible and organized.
